estimator_configuration.design: Exploratory paired reconstruction on existing clean simulated trajectories, with new noise seeds101/307/911. Fixed hyperparameters are recorded before this campaign, but the flow families and H+k10 prior were inspected in earlier campaigns; this is not independent blind held-out confirmation. Clean velocity is used only for injection amplitude and evaluation. Every estimator receives observed velocity and times only; postprocessing receives geometry only. Equal20%RMS does not make noise distributions equally difficult.
estimator_configuration.scope: Seven 128x128 velocity trajectories, five noises, three seeds and ten methods: 1050 raw fits and 3150 evaluations of those fits. H and H+k10 never refit an estimator. Non-Newtonian stresses and conformation are not reconstructed by these velocity-only estimators.
estimator_configuration.cost_scope: One single-BLAS-thread isolated child per fit; fit and postprocess CPU/wall/RSS profiles are separate from evaluation. Absolute child RSS includes runtime and inherited observations/reference. Timing is descriptive on a shared host; no repeated-cost uncertainty is claimed. Postprocess RSS is the accumulated child lifetime peak and may inherit prior fit/evaluation peaks; it is not incremental projection memory.

observation: Exact copy of computed clean velocity; no additive noise, no RMS normalization

contracts.inherited_20pct_regularization: All primary estimator hyperparameters retained exactly, including stable noise_intensity=.20; inherited regularized contract for the 20% experiment applied without noise, not known-noise zero.
contracts.known_zero_noise: Only stable_rpca and stable_tls_r8 repeat with noise_intensity=0 explicitly supplied; known-zero-noise control, not a selected hyperparameter.

design: Exploratory mechanism diagnosis designed after inspecting Outlier Pursuit bias on the first noisy primary flow. Not preregistered and not a new held-out validation campaign. All seven existing 128x128 trajectories retained. One deterministic estimate per flow/method/contract; three geometry-only postprocess evaluations do not refit. Optimized DMD seed101 fixed.
scope: 84 fresh-child fits, 252 raw/H/H+k10 evaluations. No new simulations. Clean SVD rank8 Frobenius lower bound is a diagnostic, not rank selection, and gives no vorticity optimum.
cost_scope: One fresh child per fit, one worker, single BLAS thread. Absolute RSS includes runtime and inherited reference/observation; postprocess lifetime RSS is not incremental. No cost repeat or population interval.
